comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of the peptide shows 37.5% similarity to Lacrain. GRAVY -0.17; Mol Wt 750.851; Mol ex. coeff 1490. A fragment of bovine beta-casein generated by two proteases of Bacillus cereus RC6, presuambly to gain a niche advantage over other competitive species. Activity: inhibition zone: Active against B. thuringiensis USDA HD22 (<30 mm), B. cereus ATCC 11778 BC45 (<30 mm), and L. monocytogenes (<10 mm). Updated 6/2018; 7/2021.
title: Two New Secreted Proteases Generate a Casein-Derived Antimicrobial Peptide in Bacillus cereus Food Born Isolate Leading to Bacterial Competition in Milk.

target_organism_text: B. cereus, B. thuringiensis, and L. monocytogenes
title: Casein derived antimicrobial peptide
